items.shortDescription: This sub-element describes how a student becomes aware of, and able to work with the individual sounds (phonemes) in spoken words. It includes blending phonemes to create words, segmenting words into phonemes, and manipulating the phonemes in spoken words. Phonological awareness is essential for students to understand the relationship between spoken and written text and to support students ‘sounding out’ words in print.
